compendium.summary: High-level long-distance movement with destination risk.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Pre-cast gate: Classify destination familiarity from evidence and prepare for every listed arrival outcome.
Failure state: Mishap, wrong destination, separation, or arrival into an unsecured scene.
Safe operating default: Carry recovery, communication, healing, and a second route; prefer prepared anchors.
